note: Small owner-run (Jim & Colleen Pope) RV park in the village of Nemaha; nightly, weekly and monthly. Call once on Hwy 67 and the hosts guide you in. No restrooms; picnic table at each site, fire pits, grill, vegetable and flower gardens guests may use, underground storm shelter. Often busy with Cooper Nuclear Station outage workers on monthly stays. Brownville 4 mi; Indian Cave State Park nearby. --Claude

Under the US$50 gate. Presence: website rulost-rvlots.com + phone 402-209-3301 (matches Google), and Google 4.9 from 57 reviews. RV Life 5.0 from 5 reviews, but two are the owners' own posts (Colleen Pope 3/2024, 'RulostRvlots' 5/2025); the three independent reviews (6/2024 $30, 9/2025 $30 one night, 7/2026 $20) are all 5 stars.

Long-stay tests: passes. A nightly rate is posted alongside the weekly/monthly ones, the reviewers are overnight motorhome travellers (one stayed one night), the owners advertise to travellers ('For all ages, not just 55+'), and there's no seasonal-lease or membership language. The note's outage-worker remark stays as a heads-up that sites can be full.
